title: SMART VAPE  E-LIQUID JUICE STRAWBERRY (60ML)
description:
The iconic strawberry is one of the most loved and versatile fruits available. Ignite your Smart Vape with strawberry flavoured e-liquid for a gentle aroma of green notes with a slight nuance of caramel. The smell is a combination of woody sweetness that is reminiscent of strolling through a light forest. The vapour cloud is as enjoyable to smell as the flavour is to taste.
Smart Vape Strawberry e-liquid is available in very convenient 60ml bottles that are easy to use and to fill tanks without spilling. Natural and artificial ingredients are used for this quality vape flavour with a 65%VG and 35%PG to offer big flavour and a vapour cloud that satisfies.
